description: This Java class Implements the CredentialHandler interface, providing methods to handle hashed credentials using login services and cryptographic hashing within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: HashedCredentialHandler
classes.description: A credential handler that hashes passwords using the OFBiz login services and cryptography utilities.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if the input credentials match the stored credentials using login service verification.

methods.name: mutate
methods.description: Generates a hashed version of the input credentials using the specified hash type.
